Container.Name: tuvima-library
Container.Overview: Tuvima Library is a self-hosted, zero-cloud media intelligence platform. Drop your books, audiobooks, comics, movies, and TV episodes into the Watch Folder — Tuvima automatically fingerprints, identifies, enriches with metadata, and organises everything into a beautiful browser dashboard. The Dashboard is published on port 5016; the internal Engine is not exposed. The container reports healthy only after both services are live. Before the first start, make sure every mapped folder is accessible to the configured UID and GID. Metadata providers are optional and may contact their configured services when enabled.

Config.Name: Dashboard Port
Config.Description: Dashboard web interface. Open http://[Unraid-IP]:5016 in your browser.

Config.Name: Library Root
Config.Description: Managed catalogue destination. The configured UID/GID needs read/write access. Mount existing read-only libraries separately in Settings instead of pointing this managed path at them.

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Persistent configuration — settings, provider weights, and organisation rules. Survives container image updates.

Config.Name: Database Folder
Config.Description: SQLite database — your entire library catalogue. Survives container image updates.

Config.Name: Models Folder
Config.Description: Persistent Local AI model files. Allow several gigabytes and keep this outside the container image.

Config.Name: Artwork and Cache Folder
Config.Description: Managed artwork, thumbnails, generated cache, and logs. Safe to place on fast appdata storage.

Config.Name: Backup Folder
Config.Description: Tuvima backup archives and restore staging. Copy important archives to another device as part of your backup policy.

Config.Name: Transcode Folder
Config.Description: Prepared playback variants and temporary transcode work. Prefer fast storage with enough free space for active jobs.

Config.Name: User ID (UID)
Config.Description: Numeric owner used inside the container. Unraid normally uses 99 (nobody). It must be able to read configured library sources and write every managed/appdata mapping.

Config.Name: Group ID (GID)
Config.Description: Numeric group used inside the container. Unraid normally uses 100 (users). Match the group permissions on every mapped folder.

Config.Name: File Creation Mask
Config.Description: Octal mask for newly created files. 0002 keeps files writable by the configured group.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for schedules and displayed local times, for example America/Chicago or Europe/London.

Config.Name: Container Network Mode
Config.Description: Explains bridge-network limitations to Tuvima. Keep bridge unless the deployment guide explicitly says otherwise.

Config.Name: Extra CORS Origins
Config.Description: (Optional) Comma-separated extra addresses the Dashboard is allowed to connect from. Useful if you access Tuvima from a different machine on your network. Example: http://192.168.1.50:5016
